items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: He was over the whole people and the former Howard, what's the matter when you didn't run?

ctx.x: Out there and there. He was over the whole people and the former Howard, what's the matter when you didn't run? I was hunting tobacco. Tobacco used to come in homes that did, you know, big homes. You couldn't put but four of them on the way. And I was hunting for them and I said, my father was this fellow. He was to come fix my daddy's boat. And so everybody had a parade. I played the parade for him. I was playing the terminal band, too. And that one morning, the father said, man, a scab just now got killed.…
Did you have any musicians in your family?
